title: The upstream, integration-remote and public-home push guards miss the same repository written another way
goal: kbpublic.is_upstream, kbpublic.is_public and kg_hooks.to_integration judge a push by the repository it reaches, not the url as written: a local path compared by os.path.samefile over the candidates git tries (path, path.git, path/.git) so a guessed suffix or a case-insensitive filesystem's spelling is caught, and a remote url compared by host and repository path whatever its scheme (https, http, ssh, scp-like user@host:path), user part, host case, trailing slash or .git suffix; a different repository that only shares a prefix is not refused

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic;t=tempfile.mkdtemp();up=os.path.join(t,'up.git');c=os.path.join(t,'clone');g=lambda *a,cwd=None:subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True);g('init','-q','--bare',up);g('init','-q',c);g('remote','add','upstream',os.path.realpath(up),cwd=c);g('config','kb.upstreamRemote','upstream',cwd=c);r=os.path.realpath(up);forms=[r[:-4]];g('remote','set-url','upstream','https://example.com/org/repo.git',cwd=c);forms2=['git@example.com:org/repo.git','https://example.com/org/repo','ssh://git@example.com/org/repo.git'];m=[f for f in forms2 if not kbpublic.is_upstream(f,c,url=f)];g('remote','set-url','upstream',r,cwd=c);m+=[f for f in forms if not kbpublic.is_upstream(f,c,url=f)];print('same-repository forms not refused:',m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)

repro_reason: a planted push needs a throwaway clone whose integration remote is a local path; the repro marks the string-equality comparison the fix replaces, and the fix's check must plant the url forms BG-lxjtp2xz's repro plants
